g.title: 📌 The most general model of humans acting together feeds the condition on all use.
📌 And so does Beauty, Good, Truth, Economy. Both, not either.
📌 Settings and context are chosen, not given — which is already an ethical act.
📌 Purposes are where the crown bites hardest: an efficient answer to an ugly purpose still fails.
📌 Who is included, and on what standing, is a Good question before it is a design question.
📌 Strategy chosen without the crown optimises the wrong thing well.
📌 Mechanism is where 'true to the ecology it sits in' stops being abstract.
📌 Outcomes are measured against the crown, not only against the plan.
📌 Time and place before purpose. Marc's extension of Meadows — context precedes paradigm.
📌 Purpose before people. Who you need depends on what it is for.
📌 People before strategy. Strategy without the stakeholders in the room produces a document.
📌 Strategy before mechanism. Deciding how to build precedes what to build with.
📌 And What comes last. Answering What first is the standard failure — it produces solutions nobody will carry.
📌 Systemic Problem Solving runs the whole nested chain, in order, with stakeholders present. Two to four hours.
📌 Walking the Tetrahedron is not one diagnostic among several — it is the governing model used as a check.
📌 Collective Action Assessment is the Who shelf applied to a real commons.
📌 Leverage points are a Why question: where would a small push do the most?
📌 And SPC closes it on What: did anything actually change, or are we reading noise?
📌 The 15 Ps land on What through Product, Persuade, Purchase, Provide, Protect.
📌 Routed to when the situation involves something held in common that is depletable and open to access.
📌 Cynefin says complex: cause and effect visible only in hindsight. Intervene without pretending to predict.
📌 Cynefin says complicated: expertise applies. Design and engineering tools.
📌 Posterity abstracts what is universal and writes it onto the shelf, where it becomes the input to someone else's Pathway 1. This is how the whole system grows.
📌 The most general model of humans taking action together.
📌 Beauty = aesthetics/passion. Good = ethics. Truth = ecology. Economy = surplus.
📌 Marc Pierson, Models for Seeing Systems. This is a precondition, not a pathway.

text.tspan: All the models below these two must be informed by
these or they will lead to no good

g.title: 📌 Ostrom gives this shelf its own spine: Origin (forming) to Performance (managing) to Survival (surviving).
📌 Heuristics fail, draw the graph, Cynefin-type it, six questions with stakeholders, AIC, BGTE check, route.
📌 The crown used as a check. Four questions, sixteen named places to look.
📌 The only method whose output is a disagreement. Independent assessments, then discuss green-vs-red splits.
📌 For complex problems. 14 leverage points, then the numbers gate, then SPC.
📌 The 15 Ps. Ends in Posterity — the move from model to pattern, which writes a new page onto the shelf.
